reviewMethod: Agent adjudication of the original run and complete synthetic source. Not an external human participant study or new model inference; the requested filename does not imply an external human reviewer.

truncationFailure.laterPolicyProtection: Any later override is a separate mitigation, not a relabelled raw result or proof of a new paid rerun.

interpretationLimits: 18/19 is status agreement on one predeclared synthetic run, not generalization accuracy or production reliability.
17/19 entire-response acceptance is a separate stricter judgment covering the incorrect title subclaim plus truncation verdict; do not conflate it with the status score.
Exact citations establish substring existence, not that every explanatory claim follows from those strings.
Only one Chinese case and one prompt-injection case were tested; no multilingual breadth or robust adversarial coverage is established.
No browser, backend, actual business operation, form email, authentication, payment or security outcome was tested by this adjudication.
Four strata remain separate; coverage-limited false adverse advice is excluded from complete-source clean-case false-positive denominators.
Later policy or prompt changes do not retroactively improve this original run. New measured claims require separately dated evidence.
